note: AAMP + state association / state registry sweep. access: open=extracted, gated=login required, pdf=unparseable file, blocked=dynamic/refused, none-found=no org.

MN.notes: Public Operators List (102 listings) with contact person, phone, address; some listings include website. WebFetch got HTTP 403 but a direct browser-UA fetch succeeded. A separate Suppliers list also exists on the same page.

WI.notes: Public Operators Directory with 134 listings (name, city, phone, service categories) on a single page; per-listing detail pages exist. The separate wi-amp.com/members area is password-protected; a Suppliers directory also exists.

IA.notes: 'Find Your Local Provider' page lists ~75 processor members with address, phone, email and 'Visit website' links (link URLs not captured). Single page, no login.

ND.org_name: North Dakota Association of Meat Processors (NDAMP)
ND.notes: NDAMP's own directory (https://ndamp.org/directory/) is members-only (login required), i.e. gated. Entries here come from the second source: ND Dept of Agriculture licensed meat plant list (state/selected/federal slaughter & processing plus custom-exempt plants; 108 establishments, no phones published).

SD.org_name: South Dakota Association of Meat Processors (SDAMP)
SD.notes: Public member-directory page lists 32 member names only - no city, phone, or links - and visibly mixes supplier members (e.g. Reiser, Handtmann, Walton's) with processors under 'Our Processor Members'. Alternate site sdamponline.com/general-7 was unreachable (connection reset, robots blocked).

NE.notes: NAMP has no public member directory (its Operators page is membership-benefits text only). Entries here come from the second source: Nebraska Dept of Agriculture Food & Meat Directory (self-listed promotional directory of 268 NE food businesses), filtered to 67 meat-related entries; may include some distributors/retailers.

MI.notes: No public member directory; site exposes only 'Become a Member' and a members-only login area (Wix). MDARD's meat processing resources page (michigan.gov/mdard/food-dairy/industry-resources/meat-processing-regulations-and-resources) links regulatory info but no public establishment list was found within budget.

MT.notes: Public members page: 48 member businesses with city and (often) website; no phone numbers published. Includes some out-of-state members (ID, OR, WA, WY, ND) recorded with their own state codes. Central Wyoming College listed Riverton (recorded as WY).

IL.notes: Public Plant Members directory with 86 listings (name, city, phone, service categories) on one page; a separate Suppliers Members directory exists. Legacy domain illinoismeatprocessors.com redirects to ilmeat.com.

TX.notes: TAMP (AAMP affiliate) publishes no public member roster on its site. Processors extracted from the Texas DSHS Meat Safety Assurance establishments-by-grant-type spreadsheet (state list, dated 1-30-2026), state-inspected 'Grant of Inspection' sheet; list truncated at 150 of ~194 inspected establishments (custom-exempt and voluntary sheets not included). Landing page: https://www.dshs.texas.gov/meat-safety/inspections-exemptions-meat-safety

OK.notes: OTMPA (AAMP affiliate for OK, joint with TX) has no member directory on its site. Processors extracted from Oklahoma Dept of Agriculture, Food & Forestry (ODAFF) Meat and Poultry Establishment spreadsheet (state-inspected, custom-exempt, and Talmadge-Aiken sheets; file dated ~2021, may be stale). ODAFF food safety page: https://ag.ok.gov/divisions/food-safety/

KS.notes: KMPA site has no public member roster; directory sits behind a Members Only section. Second source exists: Kansas Dept of Agriculture Meat & Poultry Inspection program page (https://www.agriculture.ks.gov/divisions-programs/meat-poultry-inspection) links to Inspected Slaughter/Processing Facilities (.../home/showpublisheddocument/15500/...) and Custom Exempt Facilities (.../15498/...) documents, but both downloads returned Akamai 403 Access Denied from this environment.

MO.notes: MAMP Find a Processor page links a public XLSX ('Operators Processors as of May 8 2026', https://www.mamp.co/_files/ugd/c17b4e_3db0b09813be4ebaa261d9e4192355e4.xlsx) plus a PDF map. All 125 operator-member rows extracted; a few members are out-of-state (state field kept as listed).

AR.org_name: Arkansas Cattlemen's Association (no dedicated AR meat processors association found; not an AAMP affiliate state)
AR.notes: No Arkansas meat processors association exists (AAMP lists no AR affiliate). Best public registry is the Arkansas Cattlemen's Association Processing Plant Directory, organized by 9 areas; 48 listed facilities extracted (mix of custom and USDA plants).

LA.notes: LAMPA (lampa.biz, also louisianameatprocessors.org per AAMP) publishes no member directory. Processors extracted from Louisiana Dept of Agriculture & Forestry (LDAF) 'State Inspected Red Meat Slaughter Plants' PDF (15 plants, dated 3/7/2023); LDAF meat/poultry page: https://www.ldaf.la.gov/food/selling/meat-poultry

CO.notes: CO association (AAMP affiliate, Lake George CO, 719-748-5450) has no website or public roster - Facebook page only. Processors extracted from Colorado Information Marketplace 'Custom Meat Processors' open dataset (CDA-licensed custom processors, API https://data.colorado.gov/resource/j7n8-rm2z.json). Caution: dataset appears last refreshed ~2018 (all license_expires_on = 2018-12-31); no phone numbers in dataset.

WY.notes: WMPA (Riverton WY) website wympa.com no longer resolves (DNS failure) - association appears inactive online. Processors extracted from Wyoming Dept of Agriculture 'Slaughter Operations in Wyoming' flyer (county-by-county list of custom, state-inspected, and USDA plants, current as of Summer 2023). WDA meat program page: https://agriculture.wy.gov/meat-poultry (its own 'statecustomplants' PDF contains only compliance forms, no list).

NM.org_name: New Mexico Association of Meat Processors (NMAMP)
NM.notes: NMAMP is a cooperative formed in 2024 (not an AAMP affiliate). Its Members page shows only a contact form and Join Us button - no public roster. No state plant list found either: NM Livestock Board regained state meat inspection authority via the 2024 Meat Inspection Act but publishes no processor directory yet. Contact: nmampcooperative@gmail.com, 575-554-2168.

FL.notes: Member list requires login. ~300 member companies claimed. Contact: Rochelle Sapp, Exec Director, (910) 240-3210, info@southeasternmeat.com. FL has no state meat inspection program.
